title: Fiscal configs
description: Albanian CIS fiscalization and e-invoice settings (NIPT, TCR, certificates).

help.title: About Fiscal configs
help.overview: A fiscal config is the Albanian CIS identity a till signs its receipts with: taxpayer NIPT, business unit, operator, software and maintainer codes, the cash register (TCR), the CIS endpoints, and the signing certificate. A till points at one fiscal config; a till without one does not fiscalize.

sections.title: What you enter
items: Name labels the config. NIPT falls back to the company VAT number when left empty.
Software code, business unit code, and operator code are required. Maintainer code is optional.
TCR code, TCR internal id, and TCR type (regular or vending) identify the cash register. Registering the TCR fills in the code, and needs permission to edit fiscal configs.
Fiscalization, e-invoice, and self-care URLs point at CIS; a proxy URL is optional. Environment chooses test or production.
Seller name, address, town, and country and the VAT-registered flag are printed on fiscal documents.
Certificate is a PKCS#12 file. On edit, leaving the password blank keeps the stored one.

sections.title: When a sale is fiscalized
sections.body: After a till sale is paid, fiscalization runs when the till's config is active and has a certificate.
items: The sale is signed and sent to CIS; the fiscal codes come back onto the POS order. A successful fiscal invoice is always followed by an e-invoice (UBL) registration.
Till refunds are not fiscalized automatically.
If CIS fails, the payment still completes and the error is stored on the POS order; it can be fiscalized again later.
Taxpayer lookup asks CIS for a business's details by its NIPT.

sections.title: Active and inactive
items: Deactivate stops fiscalization for every till that uses the config, without unlinking it.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
